name: Turneja Planer
description: Organizuješ DJ turneju kroz 5 gradova — biraš redosled, crew i budžet; Guncati je finalni Reputation gate.

modules.index.html: ES6 module loader, app shell, HUD DOM structure
modules.src/main.js: Entry point, game loop, event wiring, city result computation
modules.src/config.js: Sve tuning konstante: costs, travel matrix, tier tables, skill effects
modules.src/state.js: GameState shape, save/load localStorage, resource delta apply
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio SFX: card flip, city transition, crowd, win, border, prestige
modules.src/input.js: Event bus (emit/on/off), bindAction, bindSlider, keyboard shortcuts
modules.src/ui.js: HUD update, route dots, modal, toast, createCardEl, deltaHTML
modules.src/share.js: html2canvas screenshot, Web Share API, clipboard fallback
modules.src/entities/city.js: CITIES array, CITY_MAP, rollCrowd, getRoutableCities, getStartCity, getFinalCity
modules.src/entities/crew_member.js: ALL_CREW (10 members), CREW_MAP, getSkillRank, totalDailyRate, hasDJing
modules.src/systems/decision_engine.js: drawCards (no repeats, city_lock), resolveOption (random), computeEffectDelta, formatEffects
modules.src/content/cities.js: CITY_FLAVOR per grad, getCityAforizam, getArrivalMsg, getCityTagline
modules.src/content/cards.js: CARDS — sve 40 decision karata (10 L + 8 CR + 8 CE + 7 F + 7 R), CARD_MAP
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, HUD grid, game-root scroll, responsive, utility classes
modules.styles/ui.css: Cards (flip), buttons, sliders, crew grid, route cards, budget section, modal, toast, results, ending, prestige
modules.styles/game.css: Card flip animation, screen enter, city glow, dot bounce, ending glow, prestige spin, viral flash
modules.styles/theme.css: Kluboslavija/Guncati brand palette, city color tints, gradient backgrounds
